headlines.title: Supreme Court turns away Trump’s latest bid to block E. Jean Carroll award
headlines.description: The Supreme Court turned away for a second time President Donald Trump’s bid to overturn a jury verdict that awarded $5 million to writer E. Jean Carroll for alleged sexual abuse and defamation.

headlines.title: AG Todd Blanche Declines to Pledge DOJ Independence
headlines.description: As President Donald Trump’s former attorney, concerns were raised whether Todd Blanche could remain independent as most attorneys general have acted in the past. He was asked by Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker if he can pledge that the Justice Department independently of the White House. “No, I’m not going to pledge that, and no attorney general should ever pledge that” he said.

headlines.title: Trump Says Ballroom is Needed, Calling it a 'Security Structure’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is asking the Supreme Court to allow construction to proceed on his ballroom after an appeals court ruled he needed congressional authorization to build the complex. Trump is arguing that the ballroom is just a part of what will be a massive underground military complex, saying it’s a “desperately needed national security structure.” NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Iran Rebuffs Trump's US Territory Claim on Strait of Hormuz
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is responding to concerns over conditions on the USS Abraham Lincoln, dismissing concerns over long deployments. It comes as a U.S. commander toured the aircraft carrier, which has been at sea for a record of more than 240 consecutive days. headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for ‘Data Center Bill of Rights’ and says the industry needs regulation
headlines.description: The California congressman also laid out how he believes he differs from Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, as both progressives are floated as potential presidential candidates.

headlines.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says DOJ may take states’ voter roll fight to Supreme Court
headlines.description: Todd Blanche said there’s a “possibility” that the Justice Department will ask the Supreme Court to rule on cases in which the federal government’s is trying to gain access to state voter rolls ahead of November’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Democrats set their 2028 primary calendar, with South Carolina going first
headlines.description: The party’s new road map pushes Black and Latino voters and labor to the front of the line for choosing Democrats’ presidential candidate.

headlines.title: What’s next for Democrats — in November and 2027: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, “Meet the Press” moderator Kristen Welker looks at Democrats’ recent primary results and digs into what they might mean for governing next year.

headlines.title: FBI reports record decrease in violent crime in 2025
headlines.description: Both the violent crime and murder rates have decreased annually since spiking in 2022, the bureau has found. President Donald Trump touted the statistics Friday.
